verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge, so CI runners are a fair axis, but the evidence shows no runners of its own, either platform-hosted or self-hosted private runners. It only displays results from external CI: Buildkite builds appear on a CI tab and as pull request checks, and GitHub Actions results arrive as checks. That is adjacent result visibility from third-party systems, not GitCafe running pipelines.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run pipelines on platform-hosted runners or my own private runners with centralized visibility

citations.quote: GitCafe shows Buildkite builds on a repository's **CI** tab and as checks on pull requests.
GitHub Actions results arrive as checks.
